# Vendored Leaflet 1.9.4

Original runtime JS/CSS and BSD license retained. Image assets restored from the official pinned tag:
https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4/dist/images

Production manifest collection validates referenced assets. The stale `sourceMappingURL=leaflet.js.map` comment was removed: that development map was not vendored and is not present in the upstream tag's dist folder. No JavaScript runtime logic changed. Vendored CSS/license text uses LF line endings with trailing whitespace removed; CSS rules and license wording are preserved.
